name: Azacitidine (single-agent hypomethylating)

institution.provenance: DRAFT decision-support protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Full neutropenic supportive care: infection prophylaxis, transfusion support for anemia/thrombocytopenia.
Transfusion support and antimicrobials as needed.
monitoring: CBC with differential and marrow response after count recovery.
Response assessment after 4-6 cycles (delayed responses are common).

drugs.name: Azacitidine
drugs.notes: 75 mg/m2 SC or IV on days 1-7 of each 28-day cycle as single-agent lower-intensity therapy for unfit/frail patients (decitabine 20 mg/m2 IV days 1-5 or low-dose cytarabine are alternatives). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) / DeVita, general reference.
